```{r}
SCOP_rename <- function(h5_cb, ind, sun) {
  newind <- paste0("_", ind)
  newobj <- substr(deparse(substitute(h5_cb)), 1, 2)
  colnames(h5_cb) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(h5_cb)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  print(paste0(newobj, " appended _", ind)) #check object name and appended underscore
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(sun)) #intersect cellbender and SCOP file to only keep called cells
  h5_cb <- h5_cb[, keep.cells] #subset cellbender matrix
  print(paste0("Cells from cellranger.h5 present in SCOP object: ", (length(keep.cells))))
  
  h5_cb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = h5_cb, min.cells = 10) #Seurat object
  
  lane <- paste0("SI-TT-", newobj) #get lane ID by pulling object name
  print(paste0("Cells of corresponding lane present in SCOP object: ", (sum(sun$orig.ident %in% c(lane)))))#Check number of cells with corresponding lane metadata
  
  lane <- paste0(lane, "_", deparse(substitute(sun))) #create unique lane identities
  h5_cb$old.ident <- lane #add to metadata
  hashes <- sun@meta.data #take SCOP metadata
  h5_cb <- AddMetaData(h5_cb, hashes) #add SCOP metadata
  
  DefaultAssay(h5_cb) <- "RNA"
  h5_cb <- NormalizeData(h5_cb)
  h5_cb <- FindVariableFeatures(h5_cb, selection.method = "vst", verbose = F)
  return(h5_cb)
}


SCOP_rename_cellbender <- function(h5_cb, h5_cr, ind, sun) {
  newind <- paste0("_", ind)
  newobj <- substr(deparse(substitute(h5_cb)), 1, 2)
  colnames(h5_cb) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(h5_cb)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  colnames(h5_cr) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(h5_cr)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  print(paste0(newobj, " appended _", ind)) #check object name and appended underscore
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(sun)) #intersect cellbender and SCOP file to only keep called cells
  h5_cb <- h5_cb[, keep.cells] #subset cellbender matrix
  print(paste0("Cells from cellranger.h5 present in SCOP object: ", (length(keep.cells))))
  
  h5_cb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = h5_cb, min.cells = 10) #Seurat object
  h5_cb[['v147']] <- h5_cb@assays$RNA@counts['v147',] #Save virus counts as metadata
  h5_cb$infected <- (h5_cb@assays$RNA@counts['v147',]>0) #Mark virus positive cells
  print(paste0("Cells expressing v147 in CB: ", sum(h5_cb$infected)))
  
  lane <- paste0("SI-TT-", newobj) #get lane ID by pulling object name
  print(paste0("Cells of corresponding lane present in SCOP object: ", (sum(sun$orig.ident %in% c(lane)))))#Check number of cells with corresponding lane metadata
  
  lane <- paste0(lane, "_", deparse(substitute(sun))) #create unique lane identities
  h5_cb$old.ident <- lane #add to metadata
  hashes <- sun@meta.data #take SCOP metadata
  h5_cb <- AddMetaData(h5_cb, hashes) #add SCOP metadata
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(h5_cr)) #intersect filtered cellbender cells with cellranger matrix to only keep matching cells
  print(paste0("Cells intersecting CB and CR objects: ", (length(keep.cells)))) #Check intersect
  mat <- h5_cr[, keep.cells] #subsetting cellranger matrix
  h5_cb[["CR"]] <- CreateAssayObject(mat, min.cells = 10) #add cellranger counts as a new assay to Seurat object
  h5_cb[['v147_CR']] <- h5_cb@assays$CR@counts['v147',] #Save virus counts as metadata
  h5_cb$infected_CR <- (h5_cb@assays$CR@counts['v147',]>0) #Mark virus positive cells
  print(paste0("Cells expressing v147 in CR: ", sum(h5_cb$infected_CR)))
  
  DefaultAssay(h5_cb) <- "RNA"
  h5_cb <- NormalizeData(h5_cb)
  h5_cb <- FindVariableFeatures(h5_cb, selection.method = "vst", verbose = F)
  return(h5_cb)
}

Intersect_test <- function(query, reference, sun, ind){
  newobj <- substr(deparse(substitute(reference)), 1, 2)
  lane <- paste0("SI-TT-", newobj)
  newind <- paste0("_", ind)
  colnames(query) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(query)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  colnames(reference) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(reference)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  print(paste0(newobj, " appended _", ind)) #check object name and appended underscore
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(query), colnames(reference)) 
  print(paste0("Intersect tapseq & cellbender: ", length(keep.cells)))
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(query), colnames(sun)) 
  print(paste0("Intersect tapseq & SCOP: ", length(keep.cells)))
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(sun), colnames(reference)) 
  print(paste0("Intersect cellbender & SCOP: ", length(keep.cells)))
}


SCOP_rename_tapseq <- function(h5_cb, h5_cr, ind, sun, tapseq) {
  newind <- paste0("_", ind)
  newobj <- substr(deparse(substitute(h5_cb)), 1, 2)
  colnames(h5_cb) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(h5_cb)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  colnames(h5_cr) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(h5_cr)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  colnames(tapseq) <- gsub('-1',newind,colnames(tapseq)) #SCOP pipeline changes dashes to underscores
  print(paste0(newobj, " appended _", ind)) #check object name and appended underscore
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(sun)) #intersect cellbender and SCOP file to only keep called cells
  h5_cb <- h5_cb[, keep.cells] #subset cellbender matrix
  print(paste0("Cells from cellbender.h5 subset present in SCOP object: ", (length(keep.cells))))
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(tapseq)) #intersect cellbender and SCOP file to only keep called cells
  h5_cb <- h5_cb[, keep.cells] #subset cellbender matrix
  print(paste0("Cells from cellbender.h5 subset present in Tapseq object: ", (length(keep.cells))))
  
  h5_cb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = h5_cb, min.cells = 10) #Seurat object
  h5_cb[['v147']] <- h5_cb@assays$RNA@counts['v147',] #Save virus counts as metadata
  h5_cb$infected <- (h5_cb@assays$RNA@counts['v147',]>0) #Mark virus positive cells
  print(paste0("Cells expressing v147 in Cellbender: ", sum(h5_cb$infected)))
  
  lane <- paste0("SI-TT-", newobj) #get lane ID by pulling object name
  print(paste0("Cells of corresponding lane present in SCOP object: ", (sum(sun$orig.ident %in% c(lane)))))#Check number of cells with corresponding lane metadata
  
  lane <- paste0(lane, "_", deparse(substitute(sun))) #create unique lane identities
  h5_cb$old.ident <- lane #add to metadata
  hashes <- sun@meta.data #take SCOP metadata
  h5_cb <- AddMetaData(h5_cb, hashes) #add SCOP metadata
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(h5_cr)) #intersect filtered cellbender cells with cellranger matrix to only keep matching cells
  print(paste0("Cells intersecting Cellbender and Cellranger objects: ", (length(keep.cells)))) #Check intersect
  mat <- h5_cr[, keep.cells] #subsetting cellranger matrix
  h5_cb[["CR"]] <- CreateAssayObject(mat, min.cells = 10) #add cellranger counts as a new assay to Seurat object
  h5_cb[['v147_CR']] <- h5_cb@assays$CR@counts['v147',] #Save virus counts as metadata
  h5_cb$infected_CR <- (h5_cb@assays$CR@counts['v147',]>0) #Mark virus positive cells
  print(paste0("Cells expressing v147 in Cellranger: ", sum(h5_cb$infected_CR)))
  
  keep.cells <- intersect(colnames(h5_cb), colnames(tapseq)) #intersect filtered cellbender cells with tapseq matrix to only keep matching cells
  mat <- tapseq[, keep.cells] #subsetting tapseq matrix
  h5_cb[["TS"]] <- CreateAssayObject(mat, min.cells = 10) #add cellranger counts as a new assay to Seurat object
  h5_cb[['v147_TS']] <- h5_cb@assays$TS@counts['v147',] #Save virus counts as metadata
  h5_cb$infected_TS <- (h5_cb@assays$TS@counts['v147',]>0) #Mark virus positive cells
  print(paste0("Cells expressing v147 in Tapseq: ", sum(h5_cb$infected_TS)))
  
  DefaultAssay(h5_cb) <- "RNA"
  h5_cb <- NormalizeData(h5_cb)
  h5_cb <- FindVariableFeatures(h5_cb, selection.method = "vst", verbose = F)
  return(h5_cb)
}
```

```{r}
variable_names <- c(A5_sun1, A6_sun1, B5_sun1, B6_sun1, C5_sun1, C6_sun1, D5_sun1, E5_sun1, F5_sun1, D6_sun2, E6_sun2, F6_sun2, A1_sun3, A3_sun3, A5_sun3, A6_sun3, A7_sun3, A9_sun3, A8_sun4, C1_sun4, C4_sun4)#list of all Seurat objects

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(variable_names) #intregration features across all Seurat objects

variable_names <- lapply(X = variable_names, FUN = function(x) {
  x <- ScaleData(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- RunPCA(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
}) #apply these features for scaling and PCA on all Seurat objects separately

anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = variable_names, reference = c(1, 2, 7, 10, 14, 18, 19), anchor.features = features, reduction = "rpca", dims = 1:50) #create anchorset with all Seurat objects and their variable features

```

```{r}
integrated <- ScaleData(integrated)
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated)
integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, dims = 1:50)
integrated <- FindClusters(integrated)
integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, dims = 1:50)
qs::qsave(integrated, file = paste0(filepath,"7plex_integrated.qs"))
```



```{r}
integrated <- qs::qread("7plex_integrated.qs")
tapseq <- subset(integrated, cells = Cells(integrated)[integrated@meta.data$old.ident %in% c("SI-TT-A5_sun1","SI-TT-A6_sun1", "SI-TT-B5_sun1", "SI-TT-B6_sun1", "SI-TT-C5_sun1", "SI-TT-C6_sun1", "SI-TT-D5_sun1", "SI-TT-F5_sun1", "SI-TT-D6_sun2")])
gene <- c("Agrp", "Kiss1", "Npy", "Lepr", "Glp1r", "Pomc", "Tbx19", "Ghrh", "Sst", "Calcr", "Ramp3", "Htr2c", "Mc3r", "Mc4r", "Ghsr", "Nr5a1", "Socs3", "Fgfr1", "Insr", "Gipr", "v147")

purrr::map(gene, function(x) {
  df <- data.frame(ts = tapseq@assays$TS@counts[x,], cr = tapseq@assays$CR@counts[x,])
  df <- df[df$cr>0,]
  plot(df$cr,df$ts, main = x)
  lm(ts~cr, data=df) %>% broom::tidy(.)
})


```

```{r}
comp1 <- subset(integrated, cells = Cells(integrated)[integrated@meta.data$old.ident %in% c("SI-TT-F5_sun1")])

comp2 <- subset(integrated, cells = Cells(integrated)[integrated@meta.data$old.ident %in% c("SI-TT-C4_sun4")])
comp2 <- comp2[, sample(colnames(comp2), size =10000, replace=F)]

purrr::map(gene, function(x) {
  df <- data.frame(nonamp = comp1@assays$CR@counts[x,], preamp = comp2@assays$CR@counts[x,])
  plot(df$nonamp,df$preamp, main = x)
  lm(nonamp~preamp, data=df) %>% broom::tidy(.)
})
```
